title: Sensational news! 爆炸性新闻！
description: A dialogue lesson in which a reporter interviews the film star Karen Marsh, who says she has just made a new film but is going to retire because she feels very tired. Kate and Liz then read about the news in a newspaper, and the reporter's account is reported in indirect (reported) speech. The story introduces the structures for reported speech: 'Let's ...', 'She told me she had just made a new film' (tense backshift), and 'I wonder why!'. The workbook drills comprehension of the dialogue and the newspaper article, and choosing between 'told' and 'said'; the grammar workbook changes direct speech into indirect speech.
answer_note: The dialogue is the lesson text. Practice A (comprehension: the dialogue and the newspaper article) and Practice B (write in told or said) are from the workbook answer key (source-key, img/key-129-135.jpg p.216). Grammar I (change direct speech into indirect speech according to the example) and II (change direct speech into indirect speech) are from the grammar workbook answer key (source-key, pdf p.568). Grammar source audit: see reports/grammar-source-audit.json; source section order, complete prompts and answers restored.

lesson.text: Listen to the tape then answer this question. What reasons did Karen Marsh give for wanting to retire? 听录音，然后回答问题。卡伦·马什说她为什么想要退休？
lesson.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。卡伦·马什说她为什么想要退休？

lines.speaker: REPORTER
lines.text: Have you just made a new film, Miss Marsh?
lines.translation: 您刚拍完一部新电影吗，马什小姐？

lines.speaker: REPORTER
lines.text: Are you going to make another?

lines.speaker: MISS MARSH
lines.text: I don't want to make another film for a long time.
lines.translation: 我早就不想再拍片子了。

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.text: 'Karen Marsh: Sensational News! By our reporter, Alan Jones.
lines.translation: 「卡伦·马什：爆炸性新闻！由本报记者艾伦·琼斯报导。

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.text: Karen Marsh arrived at London Airport today.
lines.translation: 卡伦·马什今天到达伦敦机场。

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.text: She was wearing a blue dress and a mink coat.
lines.translation: 她穿着一身蓝色的套装和一件貂皮大衣。

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.text: She told me she had just made a new film.
lines.translation: 她告诉我她刚拍完一部新片子。

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.text: She said she was not going to make another.
lines.translation: 她说不准备再拍电影了。

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.text: She said she was going to retire.

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.text: She told reporters she felt very tired and didn't want to make another film for a long time.'
lines.translation: 她告诉记者她感到很疲劳，早就不想再拍电影了。」

items.title: 1. Let's = Let us.
items.text: 常用于第一人称的祈使句中，用来表示请求、建议、命令。

items.title: 2. She told me she had just made a new film.
items.text: 这是间接引语的又一个例子，这句话中含有一个用过去时引述动词的结构。如果我们对一下马什小姐对记者说的话（直接引语）和报上刊载的记者的复述（间接引语），就不难发现，间接引语的动词时态往往要倒移。而这种倒移的普遍规则是：现在时变成过去时，现在完成时变成过去完成时。

practice.title: Practice A: Comprehension
practice.instruction: Look at the dialogue on Students' Book page 269 and answer these questions. Now answer these questions about the newspaper article. 参见学生用书第269页上的对话，然后回答以下问题。再根据报上文章回答以下问题。
practice.translation: 参见学生用书第269页上的对话，然后回答以下问题。再根据报上文章回答以下问题。
practice.context: 12 comprehension questions: 6 about the dialogue and 6 about the newspaper article.

questions.prompt: Who is interviewing Karen Marsh?
questions.answer: A reporter (Alan Jones).

questions.prompt: Has she just made a new film?
questions.answer: Yes, she has.

questions.prompt: Is she going to make another film?
questions.answer: No, she isn't.

questions.prompt: What is she going to do?
questions.answer: She is going to retire.

questions.prompt: How does she feel?
questions.answer: She feels tired.

questions.prompt: Does she want to make another film for a long time?
questions.answer: No, she doesn't.

questions.prompt: What did Karen Marsh do today?
questions.answer: She arrived at London Airport.

questions.prompt: What was she wearing?
questions.answer: (She was wearing) a blue dress and a mink coat.

questions.prompt: What did she tell Alan Jones about making a new film?
questions.answer: She told him (that) she had just made a new film.

questions.prompt: What did she say about making another one?
questions.answer: She said (that) she was not going to make another one.

questions.prompt: Did she say she was going to retire?
questions.answer: Yes, she did.

questions.prompt: What did she tell reporters?
questions.answer: She told reporters (that) she felt very tired and (that) she didn't want to make another film for a long time.

practice.title: Practice B: Vocabulary
practice.instruction: Write in the verb told or said in these sentences. 用 told 或 said 填空。
practice.translation: 用 told 或 said 填空。
practice.context: 5 fill-in items choosing told or said.

questions.prompt: The reporter ___ me that he had interviewed a famous actress.
questions.answer: told

questions.prompt: She ___ that she had some sensational news.
questions.answer: said

questions.prompt: They ___ us they were going abroad soon.
questions.answer: told

questions.prompt: He ___ that his wife was a teacher.
questions.answer: said

questions.prompt: The boy ___ his mother he didn't want to go to school.
questions.answer: told

grammar.title: Grammar I: Change the direct speech into indirect speech

grammar.key_source: pdf p.568 (新概念英语语法练习1)
